provenance.scope: Analysis of the freshly extracted native lifecycle records; no game execution or runtime XLua verification.

result.scope: Static native branches of the fingerprinted installed client. No game execution or runtime XLua verification. No project source or tests changed.

claims.claim: LIMITED plus duration zero preserves zero m_lifeTime; it does not rewrite the configured LifeType enum to IMMEDIATELY.
evidence: metadata.json LifeType IMMEDIATELY=0 LIMITED=1 INFINITY=2 CUSTOM=3
native.json method 66092 Reset: 0x1806d647d..0x1806d6530
expanded.json 0x184741640: type0 returns 0; type2 returns sentinel; other types return the supplied FP value

claims.claim: Ordinary get_isFinished is m_isFinished || (m_started && MathUtil.IsZero(m_lifeTime)). Exact zero satisfies the latter after OnStart.
evidence: native.json method 66080: 0x1806dddc3..0x1806dde0a
expanded.json 0x1869459c0 MathUtil.IsZero

claims.claim: For an initialized owner and zero-root lifetime unchanged by content, NewBuff executes OnStart, then observes finished and immediately removes/finishes the root before enabling it. No root OnTick is required.
evidence: native.json method 66301: OnStart at0x1806b6fe5, isFinished at0x1806b705f, FinishAndRemove at0x1806b707e; normal set_isEnabled is only later at0x1806b70ac
native.json method 66123 OnStart: event0 at0x1806d5035 then started=true at0x1806d503c
native.json method 66092 Reset: enabled/started flags cleared at0x1806d61af..0x1806d61c2

claims.claim: Root start actions and finish actions can execute. Ordinary root OnEnable attribute/abnormal publication, its OnEnable actions and periodic trigger do not occur. A never-enabled root has no corresponding OnDisable transition.
evidence: native.json method 66123 OnStart event0
native.json methods 66362 and66363: remove then MarkFinish, ClearDerivedBuffsIfNot, event1 at0x1806cd867
native.json method 66121: Attributes.AddModifier at0x1806d22d9 before event24
native.json method 66249: OnDisable work requires actual enabled-state change
native.json method 66233: event actions reach ActionUtil.RunActions at0x1806dbe7b without an enabled-state guard for start/finish callers

claims.claim: CreateBuff installs a child completely before registering the derived relationship. Nonzero/infinite children may enable and run their own start/enable actions during the zero-root start program.
evidence: native.json method 98388: Entity.AddBuff at0x1810bf8d9, then AddDerivedBuffSafe at0x1810bf911
metadata.json CreateBuff fields _isDerivedBuff at0x24, _finishDerivedBuffIfParentFinish at0x25

claims.claim: Registered derived children are marked finished when the parent is cleaned up; nonderived children are not automatically cleaned by that relation. Already-issued actions are not rolled back.
evidence: native.json method 66101 MarkFinish: set_isEnabled(false), set explicit finished, ClearDerivedBuffsIfNot
native.json method 66257 ClearDerivedBuffsIfNot: child MarkFinish at0x1806ce697
native.json method 66116 AddDerivedBuffSafe: finished-parent branch optionally MarkFinish child at0x1806cdf9f

claims.claim: A first trigger interval of zero initializes the timer; it does not itself dispatch an immediate OnTrigger during normal installation. Ordinary periodic triggering needs a later OnTick. Explicit content trigger actions are outside this conclusion.
evidence: native.json method 66092 Reset: timer Reset at0x1806d6750 and SetRemainingTime at0x1806d67e7
native.json method 66126 OnTick: early finished check0x1806d5560; timer advance at0x1806d5635 and OnTrigger at0x1806d565a
native.json method 66125 OnTrigger additionally requires enabled state

limits: No assertion that every official burst has initial duration zero; this batch determines the engine behavior if zero is supplied.
Child duration, binding and action effects are template-specific. Root lifetime zero does not imply zero child lifetimes or no emitted damage.
OnStart programs may rewrite their own lifetime or explicitly manipulate enabled state; conclusions above state the ordinary unchanged-lifetime path.

The generic life-type leaf at0x184741640 has an explicit0x14-byte extraction boundary covering all its local branches and returns. Other method main ranges and their continuations have fullyDecoded=true; this is not a claim to have unfolded every downstream action implementation.
